eps.ov: Raishin Akabane, an exchange student from Japan, arrives at the Walpurgis Royal Academy of Machinart with a goal: use his beautiful automaton Yaya to become the world's most powerful mage, gain access to the forbidden arts, and use them to kill a man.
eps.oa: يصل «رايشين أكابانه»، طالب التبادل من اليابان، إلى «أكاديمية فالبورغيس الملكية للماكينارت» وله غاية: أن يستعمل «الأوتوماتون» الجميلة «يايا» ليصير أقوى ساحر في العالم، فينال الوصول إلى الفنون المحرّمة، ويستعملها ليقتل رجلاً.

eps.ov: One of the Rounds makes Raishin an offer he can't refuse. In exchange for a festival entry, he'll have to investigate a mysterious puppeteer who eats automatons' hearts right out.
eps.oa: يعرض أحد «الراوندز» على «رايشين» عرضاً لا يُرد: مقابل مقعد في «الحفل الليلي» عليه أن يتحرى أمر محرّك دمى غامض يلتهم قلوب الأوتوماتون.

eps.ov: Raishin and Yaya receive some unexpected visitors. Meanwhile, Felix and Charlotte each set out to capture "Cannibal Candy," but their plans have irreconcilable differences.
eps.oa: يتلقى «رايشين» و«يايا» زواراً لم يتوقعاهم. وفي الأثناء ينطلق «فيليكس» و«شارلوت» كلٌّ ليأسر «كانيبال كاندي»، لكن خطتيهما بينهما خلاف لا يُجسر.

eps.ov: It's time for the final battle with Cannibal Candy, but is Yaya too wounded to fight?
eps.oa: حانت المعركة الأخيرة مع «كانيبال كاندي»، لكن أتكون «يايا» أشد جراحاً من أن تقاتل؟

eps.ov: Raishin and Yaya come back from an exercise session to find a strange girl hanging from the ceiling of their room... and things only get weirder from there.
eps.oa: يعود «رايشين» و«يايا» من حصة تدريب فيجدان فتاة غريبة معلقة من سقف غرفتهما... ثم لا تزداد الأمور إلا غرابة.

eps.ov: Raishin discovers the mystery behind Frey's actions, but it's not what he expected.
eps.oa: يكشف «رايشين» السر وراء تصرفات «فراي»، لكنه ليس ما توقعه.

eps.ov: With Raishin in intensive care hovering between life and death, brother and sister must battle each other on the second night of the festival.
Loki and Raishin form a hostile alliance--or something--to defeat the man who's toying with them all.

Raishin learns about a troubled new transfer student, Charlotte's acting strangely, and someone at the academy is under attack. With all that going on, can even a meddler extraordinaire like Raishin manage to help everyone?

Henriette and Raishin are trapped underground, with a cave-in threatening to happen at any moment. And as if that weren't bad enough, someone else is lurking down there that nobody wants to be stuck in a small, enclosed space with...
Cedric and his butler are playing a game with no clear winners, and time is running out for Charlotte and Henriette.
One battle ends--but with the promise of many more in store.
